requirements_summary: Building an IDE copilot that is repository-aware: must surface precise function-level context using embeddings + vector DB. Needs low-latency streaming completions for in-IDE experience (<50ms local latency target for suggestions, ~200 req/s concurrency for internal beta). Must support model/version pinning per feature flag and deterministic fallbacks. Vector DB must be deployable in customer VPC or on-prem for EU customers; prefer Milvus or self-hosted Faiss pipeline with upsert + incremental embedding updates. Chunking: file-level + symbol-aware chunks (keep doc-level token window <= 2048), prefer commit-level anchors and PR-filtering to avoid indexing WIP branches. Security: SSO/SAML, per-repo access control, KMS-managed keys, audit logs, retention controls (30/90/365 day tiers), and clear data residency (EU region isolated).

technical_notes:
- Chunking strategy: symbol-aware splitting, preserve function/cls boundaries; max chunk tokens 1,500; overlap 128 tokens.
- Embedding dims targeted: 1536 for dual-encoder; consider 1024 for throughput bench.
- Vector DB ops: incremental upsert pipeline via Kafka; TTL for temporary PR contexts (7 days).
- Routing: prefer Dedicated for internal real-time dev flows, Hosted for public sandbox.
- Fallback policy: pinned model -> quantized variant -> cheaper hosted model.
- Metrics: token cost per suggestion, contextual recall@k, end-to-end suggestion latency.
